summary: Kerb beside a small grassed reserve where cars already park; homes across the road.

best_section.where: South kerb of Raglan Street beside the small reserve, just past the corner

drivers.seclusion: South side is a grassed reserve with trees; dwellings 18-21 m away across the road on the north side.
drivers.access_and_room: Open sealed street with parked cars in the kerb lane; room for a van beside them.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street just off a busy road; corner is close.
drivers.convention: Cars parked along this kerb in the QLD image, so a van would blend in.

flags: Noise from the busy road at the corner
sun_shade: Open to the north and east; trees in the reserve shade the south side in the afternoon.
